sheets.title: MECHANICAL LEGEND AND ABBREVIATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Cover/legend sheet for the mechanical set. Contains HVAC legend (fan types FF-1, exhaust fan; LV-1, LV-2 stationary louvers; MD-1/MD-2 motorized dampers; UH-1 unit heater), abbreviations, general notes (13 items), construction notes (3 items – all work per City of Chesapeake DPU specs, refer to City Public Facilities Manual, refer to City standard submersible VFD/soft starter and PLC panel drawings). Arc Flash Hazard Analysis Note on right side mirrors the electrical set – contractor to perform study and submit as part of 50% drawing phase. Project number 2024-011, date 02/05/2026, drawn by RJO.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL SITE PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Site plan at 1"=10' scale. Shows pump station footprint (roughly 30'×39' total site area including concrete pad areas), wet well (circular), pump/control building, proposed utility and access easement, generator pad to south of building. Proposed 12" DI water main runs along top/north of site. 10" PVC force main routes east from pump station. 5/8" water meter shown. 6" emergency pump connection shown on north side. Proposed utility/access easement shown on west side. Site appears to be in a residential subdivision context (houses shown to west/lower-left).

sheets.title: HVAC FLOOR PLANS
sheets.reading_notes: Upper level and lower level floor plans at 3/8"=1' scale. Upper level shows: control room at right side; exhaust fans EF-1 (wet well exhaust) and FF-2 (control room exhaust fan); motorized dampers MD-1, MD-2; unit heater UH-1; backdraft dampers BDD; louvers LV-1/LV-2 (stationary, extruded aluminum). NEMA 4X SS stilling well junction box detail referenced to M-4. Lower level shows wet well (circular, dominant feature) with level transducer in 6" Sch-80 PVC stilling well, high level float switch, high level backup float switch, Hi-Hi float switch. 9 key notes on sheet. Note indicates motorized dampers always in closed position when EF-1 is de-energized; upon exhaust fan energizing, MDs open to full open and exhaust fan starts.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Details sheet with 6 detail drawings: (1) Submersible Level Transducer and Stilling Well Detail – 12"×12"×8" NEMA 4X SS enclosure, ½" signal cable to PCP, 4" Schedule 80 PVC pipe, 3/4" VENT 110 F, 5/8" SS bolts; (2) Wet Well Exhaust Fan Detail – direct drive, aluminum birdscreen, 24" max fan diameter, 20" max curb size, concrete slab mounting; (3) Wall Mounted Exhaust Fan Detail – extruded stationary louver, birdscreen, backraft damper, exterior/interior section; (4) Unit Heater Mounting Detail – support and bracket by manufacturer, provide 18" clearance from ceiling; (5) Louver-Motorized Detail – 8-gauge galvanized mounting collar, 24V Belimo actuator, extruded aluminum louver, clip angle; (6) Wall Louver Detail – extruded stationary louver, birdscreen, backraft damper. All details no scale.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL LEGEND AND ABBREVIATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Cover/legend sheet for electrical set. Electrical legend includes: ceiling/wall mounted lighting, junction box (Knox Box), door alarm contact, float switch, limit switch, pressure transducer, level transducer, high temperature sensor, magnetic flow meter, unit heater, motor connection, electrical panel board, surge protective device [SPD], double throw safety switch [DTSS], pump control panel [PCP], remote terminal unit (alarm transmitter) [RTU], variable frequency drive [VFD], phase monitor [PM], power company meter. Construction Notes: (1) all per City of Chesapeake DPU construction specs; (2) refer City Public Facilities Manual Vol I, Div 43 and 44; (3) refer City standard submersible VFD/soft starter and PLC panel drawings. Arc Flash Hazard Analysis Note prominent at right – same requirements as mechanical set. Date 01/23/26 (first submittal). Project No. 2024-011.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL SITE PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Electrical site plan at 1"=10' scale matching mechanical site plan. Key additions vs. M-2: portable generator receptacle shown north/northeast of building; DE (Dominion Energy) meter shown; manual transfer switch (MTS) shown; generator pad to south. Key note 1: see Sheet E-4 for exact location of electrical equipment. DE power location noted – coordinate exact location with DE. Underground conduit to building from DE point of entry. Site layout confirms generator pad and utility connection routing.

sheets.title: LIGHTING FLOOR PLANS
sheets.reading_notes: Lighting floor plans (upper and lower level) at 3/8"=1' scale plus Lighting Fixture Schedule. Upper level shows: ceiling-mounted fixtures in pump room and control room (type A – Phoenix Lighting LED, ~1336 lumens, 17W, 5600K, 120V, surface ceiling); wall-mounted fixtures exterior (type B – Hubbell Outdoor 'Geopak TRP1' series, 2674 lumens, 28.2W, 3000K LED, 120/277V, surface wall 8' AFF, dark bronze, full cutoff, integral photocell). Panel 'MDP' referenced. Lower level (wet well) shows minimal lighting – wet well is essentially empty/no fixtures at lower level. Key note only shows 'XXXXXXX' as placeholder – note not yet filled in at 35% submittal.

sheets.title: POWER FLOOR PLANS
sheets.reading_notes: Power floor plans (upper and lower level) at 3/8"=1' scale. Upper level shows: MDP-5 (main distribution panel); VFD-3 in control room area; two base-mounted pump motors shown in wet well area (refer to electrical riser diagram for ratings/connection requirements); motorized damper MDP-1 (120V, 1/4HP) and MDP-2 (120V, 1/4HP) coordinated with mechanical controls; portable generator receptacle (42 AMP G); DE meter; manual transfer switch (MTS – 4-pole DPDT safety switch shown). 5.0kW shown near control room area. Lower level (wet well) shows: level transducer in 6" Sch-80 PVC stilling well (refer to detail M-4); high level float switch; high level backup float switch; Hi-Hi float switch. 6 key notes including: (1) connect fan to bypass thermostat and energize fan when switch in ON position; (4) main double throw safety switch lockable in all switch positions; (5) provide Knox Box for key; (6) approximate location of NEMA 4X SS wet well slab penetration junction box for float switches and level transducer.

sheets.title: DETAILS (Pump Room - Pump Station #290)
sheets.reading_notes: Detailed pump room section drawings for PS #290. Sheet shows: Section B-B (wet well section, 10'-0" wide, 12" #57 stone base, vapor barrier, filter fabric), Section A-A (corresponding section), pump room details including W8×__ steel beam for trolley hoist, pump room dimensions (16'8" and 12'8" plan dimensions shown), Keynote list (1-50). Notable keynotes: #1 Gorman Rupp VS6A60-B pump; #2 60HP 3-phase motors; #12 Bilco aluminum hatch 24"×30"; #33 exhaust fan; #48 two-ton trolley hoist (location TBD); #49 VFD must remain. Reviewer comments visible: 'NEED TO CHANGE TO NEW PUMP SPEC 60 H.P. 700 GPM', 'PUMPS MISSING!', 'THIS NEEDS TO BE ON SHEET PS-5', 'NOTES 36-50 ON SHEET PS-4 NEEDS TO BE ON SHEET PS-5', questions about locations of items 36-50 (anti-siphon hose bib, generator receptacle, pump control panel, surge protection device, panel 'MDP', double throw safety switch, Dominion meter, wall-mounted electric heater, exhaust fan with louver, RTU, intake louver, wall pack, trolley hoist). Finish floor elevation 12.90, bottom wet well -15.30.

sheets.title: DETAILS (Pump Room Floor Plan - Pump Station #290)
sheets.reading_notes: Pump room floor plan at 3/8"=1' scale. Stilling well detail shown. Plan shows pump room dimensions (12'8" width noted; room appears approximately 10'×14' based on scale). 'ADD VFD' notation appears twice. Knox Box shown. Refer note says to refer to Parts List on Sheet PS-4 for callout descriptions. Reviewer comments: 'PUMP ROOM FLOOR PLAN SCALE: 3/8"=1'-0"'. This sheet is clearly still in progress at the 35% stage.
